additional_info.subject: Issue : EN
additional_info.body:
Hello everyone,
yesterday we carried out the first charging test with a MAN truck on the
Sicharge D 400.
Test result: The charging process could not be started because
the previous cable check could not be completed after a timeout. According to ISO 15118-2, the
charging station must report a successful cable check back to the vehicle within 40 seconds.
You will find a detailed test report in the attachment.
Please forward this information to your responsible contact and then give us feedback.
Many thanks.
Best regards

additional_info.subject: New Status Change
additional_info.body: The Status was changed from Feedback Required to Technical Clarification after 3 days, 23 hours, 33 minutes and 23 seconds.

vor Ort Diagnose am 21.08.2024 auf dem MAN gelände geplant.
Ingo Oldenburg und Juan Miguel Espin Lopez <juanmiguel@ecog.io>

Result from site tests at MAN:
the original problem could not be reproduced. MAN told us that the TCP_QUICKACK is caused by an interruption of the TCP/IP stack. MAN abort he TCP/IP stack in case of an violation in the V2G communication which cannot be recovered.

the issue with the Cable Check Timeout could not be reproduced in the MAN test yesterday. Such deep problem must be recorded with special tools when it happens. In this case are the existing log is not suffcient and we need to continue when this can be recorded.
In agrement with MAN we do not need to proceed this topic.
